opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £130,000; Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years 2-3, plus up to £6,000/year research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post. Must hold a doctorate by take-up; must hold a UK degree or a UK academic position. Tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with joint salary support from the Trust and host university.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible under UKRI. Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project of up to five years. Assessed via outline and detailed application stages; the outline stage is paused and detailed applications are being accepted until 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers (some specialist arts institutions permitted) to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas. Visits of 3 to 12 months.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship, resident in the UK, with an established track record. Priority to those whose teaching/admin duties have impacted research.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research over 3 to 24 months, providing replacement costs and research expenses. Application materials will be available on the page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year, with an established record of research. Tenable at UK universities or eligible independent research organisations.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare results for publication, over 3 to 24 months. Application materials will be available on the page during September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered with the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers. Each university may submit one application as principal applicant; collaborations encouraged.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary round is expected to open in February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars embarking on a university career, with at least two years' experience after PhD, holding a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent at a UK university (or nominated with a contract offered).
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4 to 5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
